ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: REQUIRED. Admin password for RCON and REST API access. Auto-generated per deployment.

PLAYERS.description: Maximum number of players allowed to connect simultaneously (1-32). Each player slot consumes additional memory.

SERVER_NAME.description: Name shown in the Palworld server browser.

SERVER_PASSWORD.description: Optional password required to join the server. Leave empty for a public server.

COMMUNITY.description: Show this server in the public server browser.

PUBLIC_IP.description: Public IP address. Leave empty for auto-detection.

PUBLIC_PORT.description: Public port. Leave empty to use the default game port.

BACKUP_ENABLED.description: Enable automated world backups to the persistent volume.

DELETE_OLD_BACKUPS.description: Automatically delete backups older than OLD_BACKUP_DAYS.

OLD_BACKUP_DAYS.description: Number of days to keep backups before deletion.
